library: torch (custom DeepSurv impl; pycox not installed in venv)

DeepSurv_v11_richer.eval_protocol: 5-fold CV (within-fold standardization, 10% held-out val for early-stop)

method_notes: DeepSurv (Katzman 2018, BMC Med Res Methodology PMID 29482579) MLP architecture: 23/52 → 64 → 32 → 1; ReLU; Dropout(0.1); Cox partial-likelihood loss (Breslow ties via logcumsumexp). Adam(lr=1e-3, wd=1e-4); full-batch GD (n_train < 700); early-stop patience=15 on 10% held-out val. 5-fold CV chosen over LOO to keep wall time bounded; 5-fold is the published DeepSurv benchmark protocol. Within-fold standardization prevents test-fold leakage. Paired bootstrap stratified by cyto, B=10000, vs Cox_v11_routed_mmsygnal log-hazards.
